entry.name: Tithe Captive
entry.description: A chained debtor awaiting the Red Tithing.

entry.name: Valve Overpressure
entry.description: An illegal brass marrow valve in his neck: when cut low, he floods his veins for one frantic surge.

entry.name: Notched Billhook
entry.description: A garrison billhook, its hook notched by use: a two-handed pole-arm for holding a narrow corridor.

entry.name: Dented Cuirass
entry.description: A Castellan Watch cuirass, dented and hammered back into shape.

entry.name: Curfew Bodkin
entry.description: A thin curfew-runner's dagger, made to be drawn and gone before the Watch arrives.

entry.name: Soot Leathers
entry.description: Hard leathers blackened by kiln soot, stiff but light enough to run in.

entry.name: Bronze Censer
entry.description: A bronze censer on a chain: an embalmer's bowl for hot coals and burning resin.

entry.name: Copied Psalter
entry.description: A hand-copied psalter, its margins crowded with a scribe's corrections.

entry.name: Embalmer's Habit
entry.description: A stained embalmer's habit, cut loose for working over the dead.

entry.name: Winch Arbalest
entry.description: A crag arbalest with a winch crank: slow to span, hard to answer at range.

entry.name: Poacher's Coat
entry.description: A poacher's riveted leather coat, patched along every seam.

entry.name: Penal Shackles
entry.description: Riveted penal shackles worn as cestuses: the chain cut away, the iron kept for the knuckles.

entry.name: Foundry Apron
entry.description: A heavy foundry apron of scorched hide, worn by kiln stokers.

entry.name: Brass Sprayer
entry.description: A brass pressure tank and hose with a pole nozzle, charged with caustic vitriol.

entry.name: Rubbered Coat
entry.description: A tanner's rubbered coat, tacky and chemical-stained, made to shed spills and sprays.

entry.name: Watch Hookbill
entry.description: A Watch hookbill: a long-hafted axe-hook for pulling men off walls.

entry.name: Heater Shield
entry.description: A Watch heater shield, its paint worn to bare steel at the rim.

entry.name: Watch Cuirass
entry.description: A Castellan Watch cuirass of riveted plate, issued to the grate-guards.

entry.name: Watch Gambeson
entry.description: A quilted Watch gambeson, padded thick against crossbow and blade.

entry.name: Stirrup Arbalest
entry.description: A stirrup arbalest, spanned with a foot in the iron loop and a heave of the back.

entry.name: Bailiff's Maul
entry.description: A bailiff's maul: a short iron-headed hammer for gates and kneecaps.

entry.name: Penitent Scourge
entry.description: A penitent's scourge of barbed wire tails on a handle wrapped in vestment cloth.

entry.name: Pyre Nozzle
entry.description: A pole nozzle that sprays burning oil in a long stream.

entry.name: Warded Apron
entry.description: A leather apron stamped with warding marks, worn at the vats.

entry.name: Boning Knife
entry.description: A narrow boning knife from a rendering floor.

entry.name: Skinner's Apron
entry.description: A skinner's apron, stiff with old grease and cut from many hides.

entry.name: Bone Club
entry.description: A calcified bone gripped at the narrow end and swung wide.

entry.name: Executioner Bill
entry.description: Captain Vane's executioner's bill: a long billhook with a gilded haft.

entry.name: Twin Bone-Saws
entry.description: Proctor Quell's twin bone-saws, their teeth clogged with old marrow.

entry.name: Foundry Sledge
entry.description: A foundry sledge, its head scored by slag.

entry.name: Flensing Hooks
entry.description: A pair of flensing hooks from a rendering floor, swung on short hafts.

entry.name: Prelate's Blade
entry.description: A prelate's sword, narrow and plain, kept clean for ceremony.

entry.name: Slag Plating
entry.description: Kiln-quenched plate, heavy with slag and still faintly warm to the touch.

entry.name: Marrow Scalpel
entry.description: Proctor Quell's marrow scalpel, its blade stained black-green.

entry.name: Kaelen's Gouged Sigil
entry.description: A Watch sigil with its Castellan device gouged out. Kaelen's keepsake.

entry.name: Vesper's Runner Whistle
entry.description: A runner's whistle on a cord. Vesper's keepsake.

entry.name: Maren's Copyist Quill
entry.description: A copyist's quill worn to a stub. Maren's keepsake.

entry.name: Hollis's Focusing Monocle
entry.description: A corded brass monocle that sharpens the long shot. Hollis's keepsake.

entry.name: Elyse's Cracked Retort
entry.description: A cracked glass retort that still smells of alum. Elyse's keepsake.

entry.name: Dunstan's Shackle Link
entry.description: A single link of slag-black shackle chain. Dunstan's keepsake.

entry.name: Flensing Talon
entry.description: Guild-Master Orlov's flensing talon: a curved rendering blade, hooked to open what it catches.

entry.name: Bone Spur
entry.description: A claw or bone spur, kept as surgery stock for the Forearms.

entry.name: Chitin Plate
entry.description: Hide, chitin or scale cut for the Thoracic: surgery stock.

entry.name: Calcified Gland
entry.description: A hardened, mineral-crusted gland, kept as surgery stock for the Visceral.

entry.name: Amber Lens Shard
entry.description: A resin-hard lens shard for the Cranial, needed for the class rite.

entry.name: Rock Salt
entry.description: Coarse grey rock salt: it flushes the marrow at the Slab, and it passes as a bribe at the gates.

entry.name: Black-Iron Bar
entry.description: A bar of black iron, rare and heavy: Berek's Hearth uses it for training and reforging.

entry.name: Amber Tapetum Pin
entry.description: Amber Tapetum Pin, a Tier I graft: an eye-shine membrane set in at the Slab. Teaches Marrow Lash.

entry.name: Siphon-Valve Pin
entry.description: Siphon-Valve Pin, a Tier II graft: a brass marrow valve fitted as a pin. Teaches Marrow Bolt.

entry.name: Dreamer's Geode Pin
entry.description: Dreamer's Geode Pin, a Tier III graft: a shard of marrow geode set in as a pin. Teaches Marrow Rend.

entry.name: Litany Graft
entry.description: A priest's class graft, set in the Cranial. Teaches Marrow Litany.

entry.name: Inoculated Keystone (priest)
entry.description: A priest's Tier III keystone graft, set in the Cranial. Teaches Purge Marrow.

entry.name: Render-Beast Tendon
entry.description: Tough tendon from a Render-Beast: winch cord for the Hearth's arbalests.

entry.name: Repair
entry.description: Restore a weapon's durability: Scrap scaled by the missing durability; higher tiers also need fine salvage, Inquisitor arms Inquisitor steel.

entry.name: Act 1 side-hook (Warded Tallow)
entry.description: Do one errand at a ward node; paid in Warded Tallow.

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: Chirurgeon Sabina has a vial of black-green marrow in one hand and a scalpel in the other. The floor is already humming. "One of you may take this. Stage One. A pin's head start on what is coming. You will not thank me. Choose."

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: She turns the vial in the brazier light, waiting.

nodes.speaker: sabina_kress
nodes.text: The vial goes down a throat. Sabina does not watch.

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: Maren kneels by the broken cages and presses grey linen to the cage seals, copying the Clerisy's cipher letter by letter. The cages are open.

choices.text: Two cell-mates walked out of the cages.
One cell-mate walked out of the cages.
Nobody walked out of the cages.

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: Two cell-mates, brown-faced and coughing, grin crookedly as they slip Maren a pinch of Rock Salt each. "For the cipher," says one. "For the next cage." The cage-seal rubbings are legible, and they are not the Clerisy's words.

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: One cell-mate stays, rubbing their wrists. They press a grain of Rock Salt into Maren's palm and say nothing at all. She copies the seal anyway.

nodes.speaker: maren
nodes.text: Maren folds the linen away without a word. "I'll copy what's left. The names will still be on the seals."

nodes.speaker: dunstan
nodes.text: Dunstan stands in the mill-yard with his jaw wired shut and a broken slag-ladle in one fist. Nobody has asked him to speak. He holds the ladle out, handle first.

choices.text: You're one of us now. Take the next bunk.

nodes.speaker: dunstan
nodes.text: Dunstan clamps his wired jaw and nods once, a slow mortar-stone nod. Then he points at the chute where his father's bones came down, and at the mill, and at the road. He means to see all three of them smashed. Open Party (P) to swap them into the squad from the bench.

nodes.speaker: elyse
nodes.text: Elyse wipes copper-green still-sludge from her goggles and grins crookedly through the smoke. "My mother's tenement is awake, Orlov's guild is a fortnight short of tallow, and I think I need to sit down."

choices.text: Come to the Undercroft. Take the next bunk.

nodes.speaker: elyse
nodes.text: "I make alum tonic. I make tallow. I make the Spent open their eyes. If that sounds like a use, I'd like to be of it." She shoulders a bandolier of phosphorus bottles and falls in beside Vesper. Open Party (P) to swap them into the squad from the bench.
Ivo sits cross-legged on the Basin steps, still wearing the Toll-Pen number on his shirt. He is twelve, and he is not smiling. "Talia says you took the lock off the pen."

choices.text: What did you see in the pen?

nodes.text: "Ash-Crawl runners aren't safe. We're quick." He almost smiles. "I'll run for you if you want. Whistle twice."
"They count you in tallies of four. When the count's short, they pick the smallest. I counted the sentries instead. There's a gap at the third bell, when they change the chalk."

nodes.speaker: ivo
nodes.text: They let you go.

entry.name: Bailiff Corvo at the Third Ward gate
entry.speaker: bailiff_corvo

nodes.text: Bailiff Corvo leans on the gate-post with a stiff leg that has already turned to grey stone to the knee. "Third Ward gate. You want through, you leave something at the post. Salt or Scrap. I don't care who for."

choices.text: No more tolls. Force the Third Ward gate.
What do you keep behind the gate?

nodes.text: He takes the salt, tucks it into a ledger he doesn't write in, and nods. "Patrols cut short on the Third Ward side tonight. My sister Ida is sixteen and the Tithing is looking for sixteens. If it ever goes badly, don't make it worse."

He pockets the Scrap, tucks it into a ledger he doesn't write in, and nods. "Patrols cut short on the Third Ward side tonight. My sister Ida is sixteen and the Tithing is looking for sixteens. If it ever goes badly, don't make it worse."
"My sister. Ida. Sixteen. I keep the gate so I can keep her indoors. I kept my mind on clean water. It buys me a stone leg and a few more months."

nodes.speaker: bailiff_corvo
nodes.text: Corvo waves you off the post.

cards.text: The Sluice Undercroft, a day and a night later. The brazier burns low. One bunk is made, and nobody has slept in it.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: I told you iron doesn't dream. It doesn't weep either. I'd trade every valve I ever cast to have that bunk slept in tonight.

cards.speaker: sabina_kress
cards.text: Cold steel bounced off Nemeth, Berek. I watched. He does not die of anything you or I can swing. If we want to reach what he took, we have to learn what he drinks.

cards.speaker: berek_dorn
cards.text: That's how they got the prelates. That's how they got whoever he took.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: It is a question for another day. Tonight there are five of us and a gate, and by the next bell there will be a stranger at the Basin door. Eighteen, twenty-four, cowled to the eyes, asking to be taught.

cards.speaker: kaelen
cards.text: We left them there. We opened the Gate and one of us stayed on the winch. I will not forget how that sounded.

cards.speaker: vesper
cards.text: Nobody forgets. We carry it. We send a keepsake home to their bunk and we keep the door open.

cards.speaker: maren
cards.text: The chronicle says the Clerisy took thousands. I have never counted what it costs to take one. Tonight I'm counting.

cards.speaker: hollis
cards.text: I have put a quarrel through a visor before. I would trade it to keep that winch turning.
Dunstan sets his broken slag-ladle on the made bunk, handle first. His wired jaw does not move.

cards.speaker: elyse
cards.text: I make tonics for the Spent. I have nothing that makes a winch hold.

cards.speaker: talia_rusk
cards.text: Then we count together. Berek will frame the bunks, Sabina will lay out her knives, and I'll bring in the first runaway. The Bastion is next.

entry.name: The Bone-Mill Raid
entry.description: Overseer Grendel grinds uncremated Spent into bone-mortar at the Fourth Kiln. Wreck the mill and free the chain gang.

steps.text: Wreck the Bone-Mill at the Fourth Kiln

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and a new bunk.
entry.closed_text: Clear the Sweep and the Cages first.

entry.name: The Tallow Vats
entry.description: Guild-Master Orlov brings Render-Beasts and Dredgers to burn out a young chemist at the Tallow Vats. Cut through and find her.

steps.text: Cut through the Tallow Vats and find the chemist

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Orlov's Retribution; five days of Warded Tallow wait in Orlov's stores.
entry.closed_text: Clear the Sweep and the Cages first.

entry.name: The Sweep
entry.description: Captain Vane has sealed the Seventh Ward grates and the Watch is selling captives for a Bastion commission. Break the sweep at Alleyway Junction 7.

steps.text: Break Vane's sweep at Alleyway Junction 7

entry.reward: Talia's thanks, a poultice, and Vane's gate cipher.

entry.name: The Tenement Counter-Still
entry.description: Elyse will check her awakened mother's tenement block and distil tallow. The Vats' leftover stills are hot.

steps.text: Check the counter-still at the Tallow Vats

entry.closed_text: Cut through the Tallow Vats first.

entry.name: The Sweep
entry.description: M1, Tier 1: Captain Vane's grate sweep at Junction 7.
entry.intro: Vane's sweep is closing the grates, wall by wall.

effects.text: Lock shields! Seventh Ward, with me!

entry.objective_text: Break Vane's sweep before the grates are sealed.

entry.name: The Crossroads Cages
entry.description: M2, Tier 1: Proctor Quell's titration cages at the Ash-Crawl Crossroads.
entry.intro: Flagellants circle the cages while Quell works.

effects.text: A flagellant raises the scourge over the first cage.
The brass valve in Quell's neck hisses open—raw condensate floods his veins!

entry.objective_text: Free the cages before the flagellants cull them.

entry.name: Corvo's Gate
entry.description: Node 1d: the Third Ward gate, where Bailiff Corvo keeps a bribable post.

markers.label: World map: the Third Ward road

entry.name: The Tallow Vats
entry.description: Node 05: the Guild's rendering vats and still-rooms, where Tallow Dredgers boil the district's dead.

markers.label: Elyse's counter-still
markers.note: A coil of copper pipe and a leaking alum drum in the corner of a tenement block. Elyse tips a measure of clean tallow into a flask and corks it with her thumb.

entry.description: Days until the Inquisition's next tithing rite.
